nodes.description: Owner address of the Owned contract; privileged account controlling transferOwnership and transferAnyERC20Token.
Pending owner address staged by transferOwnership and consumed by acceptOwnership (two-step ownership transfer).
Public token symbol string set to 'FTC' in the FutureCoin constructor.
Public token name string set to 'FutureCoin' in the constructor.
Public uint8 token decimals set to 3 in the constructor; affects displayed token precision.
Total token supply (95000000000) minted to a hardcoded address in the constructor.
Mapping of account balances; mutated by transfer and transferFrom and read by balanceOf and totalSupply.
Nested mapping of allowances (owner => spender => amount) written by approve/approveAndCall and consumed by transferFrom.
SafeMath.safeAdd: performs unchecked a + b then require(c >= a) as an overflow guard.
SafeMath.safeSub: requires b <= a then performs subtraction, guarding underflow.
SafeMath.safeMul: performs unchecked a * b then require(a == 0 || c / a == b) as an overflow guard.
SafeMath.safeDiv: requires b > 0 then performs division, guarding division by zero.
Owned constructor assigning owner = msg.sender, establishing initial privilege.
onlyOwner function staging a new owner in newOwner without a direct overwrite of owner.
Requires msg.sender == newOwner, then promotes newOwner to owner and clears newOwner.
Token constructor that configures metadata, mints the entire supply to a fixed address and emits Transfer.
Constant function returning _totalSupply minus balances[address(0)] (burned tokens).
Constant function returning balances[tokenOwner].
ERC20 transfer: debits balances[msg.sender] via safeSub and credits balances[to] via safeAdd.
Sets allowed[msg.sender][spender] = tokens with no allowance-race checks, then emits Approval.
Spends an allowance: debits balances[from], debits allowed[from][msg.sender] and credits balances[to].
Constant function returning allowed[tokenOwner][spender].
Sets the allowance then makes an external callback into spender.receiveApproval with msg.sender, tokens, this and arbitrary data.
Payable fallback that unconditionally reverts, refusing plain ETH transfers.
onlyOwner function that makes an arbitrary external ERC20 call transferring tokens from the contract to the owner.
Caller-controlled address used for ownership checks, balance debits and allowance keys.
Unchecked uint addition a + b in safeAdd; relies on a post-hoc require rather than a checked-math primitive.
uint subtraction a - b in safeSub, guarded only by require(b <= a).
Unchecked uint multiplication a * b in safeMul, validated afterwards with a division-based require.
uint division a / b in safeDiv, guarded only by require(b > 0).
External call ApproveAndCallFallBack(spender).receiveApproval(...) executed after the allowance is written; untrusted callee can re-enter the token.
External call ERC20Interface(tokenAddress).transfer(owner, tokens) to an owner-supplied arbitrary contract address.

Subtrahend (b) of safeSub.

Address staged as the pending owner.
Account whose balance is queried.

Account the tokens are credited to.

Owner side of the queried allowance.
Spender side of the queried allowance.
Address granted the allowance and targeted by the external receiveApproval callback.

edges.reason: msg.sender is assigned directly to owner in the Owned constructor, fixing the privileged identity to the deployer.
The onlyOwner modifier compares msg.sender to owner to gate transferOwnership.
acceptOwnership requires msg.sender == newOwner, letting the staged owner claim ownership.
transfer debits balances[msg.sender], so the caller directly controls the source balance.
approve keys the allowance map on msg.sender as the token owner.
transferFrom reads and decrements allowed[from][msg.sender], making the caller the spender.
approveAndCall writes allowed[msg.sender][spender] and then forwards msg.sender into an external callback.
onlyOwner gates transferAnyERC20Token on msg.sender matching owner.
transferOwnership writes the supplied address into the pending newOwner slot.
acceptOwnership reads newOwner to validate the claimant and to emit OwnershipTransferred.
acceptOwnership overwrites owner with newOwner, completing the privilege handover.
transfer calls safeSub to debit the sender balance.
transfer calls safeAdd to credit the recipient balance.
transferFrom calls safeSub for both the balance and the allowance decrement.
transferFrom calls safeAdd to credit the recipient balance.
approveAndCall invokes receiveApproval on the spender-controlled contract, handing control to external code.
transferAnyERC20Token invokes transfer on an owner-supplied arbitrary contract address.
msg.sender is passed as the from argument into the external receiveApproval callback, letting the callee observe and re-enter with the caller identity.
Parameter a is an operand of the unchecked addition in safeAdd.
Parameter b is an operand of the unchecked addition in safeAdd.
The addition result is stored in c before the require(c >= a) validation runs.
Parameter a is the minuend of the subtraction in safeSub.
Parameter b is the subtrahend of the subtraction in safeSub.
The subtraction result is stored in the return variable c.
Parameter a is a factor of the unchecked multiplication in safeMul.
Parameter b is a factor of the unchecked multiplication in safeMul.
The multiplication result is stored in c before the division-based require validates it.
Parameter a is the dividend of the division in safeDiv.
Parameter b is the divisor of the division in safeDiv.
The division result is stored in the return variable c.
The _newOwner parameter is written into the pending newOwner state variable.
tokenOwner is used as the key into the balances mapping in balanceOf.
The to parameter indexes balances when crediting the recipient in transfer.
The tokens amount is passed as the subtrahend into safeSub.
The tokens amount is passed as an addend into safeAdd.
spender is used as the second-level key into the allowed mapping in approve.
The tokens amount is stored as the allowance value in approve.
The from parameter indexes balances when debiting in transferFrom.
The to parameter indexes balances when crediting in transferFrom.
The tokens amount is passed into the safeSub calls that decrement balance and allowance.
tokenOwner indexes the allowed mapping in allowance.
spender indexes the allowed mapping in allowance.
spender keys the allowed mapping in approveAndCall before the callback fires.
The tokens amount is written as the allowance value in approveAndCall.
The spender parameter determines which contract the external receiveApproval call is made to.
The tokens parameter is forwarded into the external receiveApproval callback.
The caller-supplied bytes data is forwarded verbatim into the external callback.
tokenAddress selects the arbitrary external contract targeted by the ERC20 transfer call.
The tokens amount is forwarded into the external ERC20 transfer call.
The constructor initialises _totalSupply to the hardcoded 95000000000 value.
The constructor mints the entire supply into balances of a hardcoded address.
The constructor assigns the token symbol string.
The constructor assigns the token name string.
The constructor assigns the decimals value.
totalSupply reads _totalSupply as the supply base value.
totalSupply subtracts balances[address(0)] from the base supply.
balanceOf returns the entry from the balances mapping.
allowance returns the nested entry from the allowed mapping.
transferFrom reads and decrements the allowance recorded in allowed.
approveAndCall writes the allowance into allowed before performing the external callback.
approve writes the granted amount into the allowed mapping.

normalization_plan.reason: Parameter a has no independent identity; it exists only as an operand of the unchecked addition.
Parameter b has no independent identity; it exists only as an operand of the unchecked addition.
Return value c merely captures the result of the addition operation.
Minuend parameter only feeds the guarded subtraction operation.
Subtrahend parameter only feeds the guarded subtraction operation.
Return value c only stores the subtraction result.
Factor a is meaningful only inside the unchecked multiplication.
Factor b is meaningful only inside the unchecked multiplication.
Return value c only stores the multiplication result.
Dividend parameter is used only by the division operation.
Divisor parameter is used only by the division operation.
Return value c only stores the division result.
Parameter is a plain input to the ownership-transfer function with no independent behaviour.
Parameter serves solely as the lookup key inside the balance query.
Recipient parameter exists only as a target of the transfer function.
Amount parameter is used only within the transfer ledger updates.
Spender parameter is only a key for the approval write.
Amount parameter is only the value written by approve.
Source parameter is only used inside the allowance-spending function.
Destination parameter is only used inside the allowance-spending function.
Amount parameter is only a ledger operand inside transferFrom.
Parameter is just the outer key of the allowance view.
Parameter is just the inner key of the allowance view.
Spender parameter only selects the callback target and allowance key.
Amount parameter only feeds the allowance write and callback payload.
The raw bytes argument has no purpose other than being forwarded into the external callback.
Address parameter exists only to choose the external ERC20 callee.
Amount parameter exists only to be forwarded into the external transfer call.
